component.name: BlitzLLVM
component.summary: BlitzBasic, Blitz3D and BlitzPlus compiler built on LLVM

description.p: BlitzLLVM compiles BlitzBasic, Blitz3D and BlitzPlus programs to native executables with LLVM, using Vulkan and SDL3.
The Flatpak holds the compiler (blitzcc), the formatter and the runtime with the shared libraries of the programs, and takes clang from the freedesktop SDK.
